counterexample_mapping.boundary: controlled_custody_channel() selects the entry named controlled:channel and proves that it differs from controlled_parent_channel
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the first channel of the registry is the channel of the parent and it is never the child

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every ledger.pass_/ledger.fail/ledger.finish follows a successful terminal write; a failed write leaves the name ATTEMPTED for the bounded recovery
counterexample_mapping.trigger: a failed terminal write advances the ledger

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the cleanup owning Try contains the construction of the endpoint and reader.start() in its body and owns the close and the drain in its finally
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the coordination try begins after the start

counterexample_mapping.boundary: record_guarded returns None and the caller advances the ledger only when the result is not None; the outer inventory recovers the ATTEMPTED names once
counterexample_mapping.trigger: a failed terminal persistence advances the ledger and suppresses the recovery

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the final document of the phase and the rewrite of the barrier document carry barrier_persisted, barrier_write_error and the identity of the original object
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the early barrier persistence diagnostics disappear

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the terminal document of r10-coordination and the terminal document of r10-early-salvage are written in the finally that owns the drain
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the earlier coordination records PASSED before its cleanup and never records the cleanup diagnostics

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the drain returns a proof failure when it is not quiescent and every caller requires the quiescence
counterexample_mapping.trigger: a nonquiescent drain yields a durable FAIL while the test continues successfully

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the exact newly retained child is selected, the identity of the target owner is compared with it and the original Thread.start is called before the exact failure is raised inside the constructor
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the constructor failure driver is unreachable because the custody lookup returns the parent channel

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every query of the registry, of the container, of the session, of the channel and of the provenance is guarded on its own and the observed thread objects are retained as an independent fallback
counterexample_mapping.trigger: one container query aborts the traversal and replaces the owners with an empty list

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every caller keeps the exact object and rethrows it before the ordinary proof assertion
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the cancellation identity is replaced, lost or never rethrown

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the cleanup owning Try starts before the construction and before reader.start() and owns the close, the join and the drain
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the independent coordination start and constructor failure bypass its cleanup

counterexample_mapping.boundary: every close of the child endpoint catches BaseException and records the exact cancellation
counterexample_mapping.trigger: the main child cleanup catches only Exception and a cancellation skips the second close

counterexample_mapping.boundary: the quiescence is part of the proof of the caller and a nonquiescent round is a proof failure of the drain
counterexample_mapping.trigger: some finalizers record the quiescence without enforcing it
